processing_timing.scope: Device-local chunk encoding/CRC and accepted packet decode/reassembly; excludes RF/ACK waits, rejected packets and PHY errors. Duplicate RX processing is separate. Zero microseconds is valid at timer resolution.

accounting.airtime_note: Configured LoRa airtime includes preamble, PHY header, PHY CRC and FEC. Payload byte counts exclude those PHY costs. Failed radio calls have unknown actual airtime; successful calls are not proof of reception. Crypto-mode airtime additionally includes metadata and its ACK, including their retries.

crypto_timing.measurement_scope: Device-local elapsed GCM operation, outside chunk/dechunk timers; key setup is separate

COM6.assumption: Device-to-host clock offset remains within pre/post calibration envelope; unsynchronized clocks, not a hard one-way timing guarantee

COM7.assumption: Device-to-host clock offset remains within pre/post calibration envelope; unsynchronized clocks, not a hard one-way timing guarantee
